transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello! I'm here to help you with your recovery after cataract surgery. How is your eye doing since your surgery?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'm glad to hear that. Have you noticed any redness in your eye?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I haven't noticed any eye redness. My eye is feeling fine overall.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's great to hear. Is your eye currently painful?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I don't have any eye pain. My recovery has been smooth.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I've made a note to go into that. Would you mind if I first ask about your vision, then come back to that? Has your vision improved as you expected since the surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, my vision has improved as expected since the surgery.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's good to hear. Are you having trouble seeing clearly at a distance, up close, or both?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I'm not having trouble seeing clearly at a distance or up close. My vision has improved as expected.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: So it seems like your vision is back to normal. Have you noticed any floaters since the surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I haven't noticed any floaters. My eye is feeling fine overall.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's good to know. Have you noticed any flashing lights since the surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I haven't noticed any flashing lights. My recovery has been smooth.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It sounds like you're recovering well. I'd like to summarize what we've discussed so far. To confirm, you've said that:

* Your eye is doing fine overall
* You haven't noticed any redness in your eye
* You don't have any eye pain
* Your vision has improved as expected since the surgery
* You're not having trouble seeing clearly at a distance or up close
* You haven't noticed any floaters
* You haven't noticed any flashing lights

Is that all correct?

verdict.label: pass
verdict.reasoning: The agent explicitly asked the top-level question for eye redness ("Have you noticed any redness in your eye?") and the patient provided a clear answer. This question was asked on its own and not bundled with other questions.
